rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for arithmetic division rather than an individual exercise.

example.english: You need division to work out this problem.
example.traditional: 呢條數要用除法先計到。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sou3 jiu3 jung6 ceoi4 faat3 sin1 gai3 dou2

rows.note: Use this for a separate part or section resulting from something being divided.

example.english: This division of the project is almost finished.
example.traditional: 呢部分工程就快做完喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 fan6 gung1 cing4 zau6 faai3 zou6 jyun4 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for an organizational division within a company.

example.english: Our company has opened a new technology division.
example.traditional: 我哋公司新開咗個科技部門。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 san1 hoi1 zo2 go3 fo1 gei6 bou6 mun4

rows.note: Use this for a difference of opinion or a split between two sides.

example.english: There is still a division of opinion between the two sides on this issue.
example.traditional: 雙方喺呢個問題上仍然存在分歧。
example.jyutping: soeng1 fong1 hai2 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 soeng6 jing4 jin4 cyun4 zoi6 fan1 kei4
